page.title: Psychological Distress (K10)
page.subtitle: 3 minutes · 10 questions
page.description: The K10 questionnaire helps assess your recent level of psychological distress.
page.disclaimer:
This tool is for self-reflection and does not provide medical diagnosis.
Kessler, R.C., et al. (2003) Copyright © World Health Organization 2003

questions.q0: During the past 30 days, how often did you feel tired out for no good reason?
questions.q1: During the past 30 days, how often did you feel nervous?
questions.q2: During the past 30 days, how often did you feel so nervous that nothing could calm you down?
questions.q3: During the past 30 days, how often did you feel restless or fidgety?
questions.q4: During the past 30 days, how often were you so restless you could not sit still?
questions.q5: During the past 30 days, how often did you feel depressed?
questions.q6: During the past 30 days, how often did you feel that everything was an effort?
questions.q7: During the past 30 days, how often did you feel so sad that nothing could cheer you up?
questions.q8: During the past 30 days, how often did you feel hopeless?
questions.q9: During the past 30 days, how often did you feel worthless?

summary.green: Your responses suggest a low level of distress. Keep supporting your wellbeing with healthy routines.
summary.yellow: Your responses suggest mild distress. Consider adding rest, recovery, and daily stress-management habits.
summary.orange: Your responses suggest moderate distress. It may be helpful to speak with a mental health professional.
summary.red: Your responses suggest high distress. Please consider contacting a mental health professional for support.
